verdict.rationale: dlt publishes an official MCP server: a probe found the dlt-hub/dlt-mcp repo, and a published server card exposes tools for inspecting, debugging and managing pipelines, secrets, schemas and runs, plus read-only SQL queries. The dltHub AI Harness docs also say these MCP servers connect to coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. missing for 10: step-by-step connection/installation documentation in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://github.com/dlt-hub/dlt-mcp
MCP server exposing tools for inspecting, debugging, and managing dlt pipelines, secrets, schemas, and runs in a dlt workspace.
Execute a read-only SQL query against the pipeline's destination dataset
The dltHub AI Harness is a set of skills, rules, and MCP servers that teach a general-purpose coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex) how to build production-grade pipelines
